title: 14-BCV-018 - Sprinkler-protected glazing in fire-resistant wall assemblies
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Neither catalogue row is marked [WITHDRAWN]; both PDFs carry Archived watermarks. R1 is the later catalogue-listed version; current legal applicability was not determined.

facts.text: The catalogue lists original 14-BCV-018 and revised 14-BCV-018R1. The R1 PDF is dated January 2019 and cites ABC Sentences 3.1.7.1.(1), 9.10.3.1.(1) and 3.2.5.12.(1).
facts.locator: Official 2014 catalogue, rows 14-BCV-018 and 14-BCV-018R1; R1 PDF, pp.1-2

facts.text: R1 permits specified sprinkler-protected interior/exterior fire-rated glazing subject to accredited evaluation to ULC/ORD C263.1-99 (reaffirmed 2018), NFPA 13 installation, listed window sprinklers, glazing, rating, location exclusions and additional system conditions.

The earlier 2018 PDF has six pages including installation guidelines and different stated conditions, including a wet-pipe system and a cited document edition; it should not be silently merged with R1.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-018 PDF, pp.1-6, VARIANCE and Appendix A

limitations: This is a provincial regulator-issued STANDATA/standing variance, not an individual application, applicant statement, project drawing, permit record or site-specific decision.
The records address the Alberta Building Code 2014 and, where noted, Alberta Fire Code 2014; do not treat them as proof of applicability under the Alberta 2023 code edition or current law.
Catalogue status is recorded as displayed on the retrieved official page. A missing [WITHDRAWN] label is not evidence of current validity; PDFs display an Archived watermark.

reuse_status: publisher_terms_apply; no blanket dataset licence asserted
